scope.entry_summary: Mark the pre-market high and low from 3:00 a.m. EST to the 9:30 a.m. open on the 5-minute chart. Enter in the direction of a confirmed break of that level after a lower-timeframe candle closes above/below it with elevated volume, or on a pullback retest of the broken level holding as support/resis­t
scope.exit_summary: Place the stop on the opposite side of the entry/breakout candle or just below/above the retest entry candle. Target at least 1R, ideally 1.5R to 2R, then trim/scale out and trail the stop to breakeven or into profit as the move extends.
